description: Simplest mixed orientable/non-orientable ribbon link (S^2 u K^2)
Linked P_+ u P_- with quaternion group pi_1 = Q_8 and t(F) = 2
Ribbon T^2 u K^2 link with abelian pi_1 = Z + Z_2
erratum_note: Yoshikawa Table II printed pi_1 = <x, y | yxyx^{-1} = 1> and E_1 = (x + 1, y - 1); actual group is abelian Z + Z_2 = <x, y | xy = yx, y^2 = 1> with E_1 = (x - 1, y - 1, 2) (noted by Ishii-Nikkuni-Oshiro 2018).

description: Ribbon S^2 u T^2 link with pi_1 = <x, y | x^2 y x^{-2} y^{-1} = 1>
1-twist-spun Hopf link (T^2 u T^2, Sanderson Dlk = (1, 1))
3-component S^2 u S^2 u T^2 ribbon link (two S^2s each linked as 6_1^{0,1} with T^2)

erratum_note: Yoshikawa Table II printed E_1 = (2x + y - 1, 4), omitting the generator (x + 1)(y + 1); integral HNF over Z[x^{+-1}, y]/(y^2 - 1) gives E_1 = (2x + y - 1, (x + 1)(y + 1), 4) (noted by Ishii-Nikkuni-Oshiro 2018).
